import json,hashlib,re
base=Path('reports/research/510300_industrial_original_archive_route_probe_v1')
def now():return datetime.now(ZoneInfo('Asia/Shanghai')).isoformat()
def read(name):return json.loads((base/name).read_text(encoding='utf-8-sig'))
def save(name,x):
 p=base/name;assert not p.exists()
 p.write_text(json.dumps(x,ensure_ascii=False,indent=2),encoding='utf-8')
files=['第一原公开入口实际读取.json','第二原法定公开入口实际读取.json','第三原历史发布目录实际读取.json','第四原历史目录实际UI末页读取.json']
rs=[read(f) for f in files]
events=[json.loads(x) for x in (base/'实际原公开导航GET账本.jsonl').read_text(encoding='utf-8').splitlines()]
assert len([x for x in events if x['event']=='REQUEST_STARTED'])==4
assert len(set(x['url'] for x in events if x['event']=='REQUEST_STARTED'))==4
assert all(r['status']=='ORIGINAL_PAGE' for r in rs)
last=rs[-1];dates=re.findall(r'(20\d{2})年(\d{2})月(\d{2})日',last['full_text'])
assert dates and min(dates)==('2024','04','16')
